context: A list command with JSON output

checklist.name: fresh_tree
checklist.description: Builds the command tree in a constructor function and injects the service; no package-level command variable or init() registration.

checklist.name: payload_writer
checklist.description: Writes the payload through `cmd.OutOrStdout()` (or an injected stdout writer), not `cmd.Println`, `cmd.Printf`, or `cmd.Print`, which default to stderr in the real binary.

checklist.name: args_validation
checklist.description: Sets an explicit `Args` validator such as `cobra.NoArgs`.

checklist.name: context_forwarded
checklist.description: Passes `cmd.Context()` to the service and executes with `ExecuteContext` in the test.

checklist.name: test_isolation
checklist.description: The test builds a fresh root, calls `SetArgs`, `SetOut`, and `SetErr`, and decodes the JSON from the captured stdout.
